LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterPipe.label: water pipe
LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterPipe.description: Plumbing for connecting wells, pumps, tanks, heaters and fixtures. Does not block movement and can run under walls. Drag with the left mouse button to lay a line quickly.
LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterTank.label: water tank
LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterTank.description: Stores water for plumbed fixtures. Capacity: 2000 L.
LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterTankGiant.label: giant water tank
LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterPump.label: water pump
LanguageData.CK_DbhWaterPump.description: Pumps ground water from wells into connected tanks. Requires power and at least one well. Capacity: 1500 L/day.
